_comment: THE ONE ACRONYM LIST, read by THREE code paths so they can never drift (2026-09-06, after narrator's CAPS_ACRONYMS and Listen's LETTERED_ACRONYMS were found diverging the day they were both written). `lettered` = capitalised tokens read as LETTERS despite carrying a vowel (FBI, USA, DNA): narrator's caps fold keeps them as printed inside an all-caps run; Listen's acronym reading SPELLS them (F B I). `spokenAsWord` = acronyms pronounced as a word (NASA, NATO, COVID): narrator keeps them as printed; Listen leaves them alone (never spelled). A vowelless token needs no entry - both readers treat it as letters by rule. Extend when a text teaches us one: a miss reads 'Usa' as a word in a book, or spells 'N A S A' on Listen. Lives under python/narrator/text so narrator can load it standalone; electron imports it relatively (resolveJsonModule) and tsc emits it into dist.
